lines.trans: It is normal that it takes time.
Nobody is rushing to your office?
I do not have an office yet!
You are too kind for this environment.
And what are you eating there?
I am eating a quinoa salad.
They contaminated you with this diet!
You look like a little dried bean.
I still have two scripts to read.
Go to bed right now!
I take naps during the day.
Where do you take these quick naps?
I sleep ten minutes in the bathroom.
You must keep your dignity, my daughter!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

meanings.en: to contaminate, to corrupt, to infect

examples.trans: I'm going to go to bed.

coucher.gloss: to go to bed, to put to bed

meanings.en: to go to bed (reflexive se coucher)

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je parle de dignité et de loyauté.
examples.trans: I'm talking about dignity and loyalty.

meanings.note: pronounced dis alone, di before a consonant, diz before a vowel
encore une heure = one more hour
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen

examples.trans: I want to see my daughter.

meanings.note: une petite fille = a little girl
the whole day as it passes; bonne journée = have a nice day
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.trans: In the middle of the table.

meanings.note: ce milieu = this world, this business

examples.text: Monsieur Audibert nous reçoit dans cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Mr Audibert will see us in five minutes.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: always feminine, even for a man
